title: The Freedom Train show
summary: He toured with the Freedom Train show in New Orleans, Memphis and St. Louis, where he was a hit.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Lee, how about the Freedom Train show?

Well, that was quite an experience that I had. I traveled with the Freedom Train show and I appeared here in New Orleans, Memphis, and St. Louis. And in St. Louis, I was very well received there on the banks of the Mississippi River where I appeared. I was only scheduled to do three songs and a dance. And I was so successful at the three songs and a dance. I had to do six songs and three dances that liked to kill me. The Post-Dispatch paper there wrote me up and said that I was the only one that woke the people up in St. Louis that could hear me coon shouting for 15 blocks. I was backed up by Russ Davis, KMOX, Augusta.
Lee, didn't you play with Martha Ray a number of years ago at the Oriental Theater?

Yes, I remember Martha Ray in Chicago at the Oriental Theater there. I worked on the bill there with her. And I got a huge kick out of her with the way she would stretch her mouth and the way she would shake when she was going off the stage.
